faq_heading: Questions about a B2B AI search visibility audit

faqs.q: How often should I run an AI search visibility audit?
faqs.a: Monthly is a sensible rhythm for most B2B companies. AI answers change from one day to the next, so a single check tells you little. Run the same prompt list each time and compare.

faqs.q: How many prompts should the audit include?
faqs.a: Start with 20 to 30 prompts that cover your category, your use cases and your comparisons. That is enough to see patterns without turning the audit into a full-time job.

faqs.q: Can I guarantee my company appears in AI answers?
faqs.a: No. No one controls what an AI assistant says. You can improve your odds by publishing clear, factual pages and earning mentions on sources the assistants trust, then measure what changes.

faqs.q: Do I need special tools to run the audit?
faqs.a: Not to begin. A spreadsheet and a fresh browser session for each assistant are enough. Tools can help you repeat the checks at scale later.

faqs.q: What does Clara AI's SEO agent do after the audit?
